name: Drop Inn
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Drop Inn in Innsbruck Discover your home away from home in the heart of Tirol!
beschreibung: The Drop Inn in Innsbruck in the Innsbruck region is a popular gathering place for anyone wishing to savor an evening over an exceptional drink. Its contemporary ambiance and laid-back atmosphere create the perfect environment to linger. The bar offers a refined selection of cocktails, long drinks, draft beers, and fine wines – ranging from beloved classics to creative original concoctions. Experienced bartenders craft each drink individually with skill and enthusiasm. Regular themed evenings provide vibrant entertainment. Whether for a relaxed after-work drink or a festive night with friends, Drop Inn is the place to be.
